messages:
sam (sec): heads-up: running a micro entitlement sweep Thurs 09:30 PT. focus: org-admin roles + cross-account KMS grants. will do a 3-service staging canary first.

lee (infra): paste the query youre using so i can validate on audit-replica.

sam (sec): simple extract on audit_events: SELECT principal, resource, binding_id FROM kms_bindings WHERE account != resource_account AND role ILIKE '%admin%' LIMIT 500; exclude tags: auto-exempt.

nora (sre): please snapshot KMS policies (JSON) before changes and schedule a 20m observation window. ill run smoke KV read/write tests.

sam (sec): agreed. owners-bot will open attestations for any vendor principals.

owners-bot: attestation tickets created: 7 open, 2 vendor principals flagged.

deploy-bot: scheduled: entitlement-micro-canary by sam at 2026-05-06T16:30Z.

lee (infra): vuln note: there's an outstanding fix (APR-22) that prevents transient escalation when roles shift. gate prune on deploy of APR-22.

sam (sec): will gate on APR-22. adding runbook link: https://go/runbooks/entitlement-micro (draft).

nora (sre): ill run a 10m DR drill during the canary to exercise emergency regrant. set rollback threshold: any failing deploy or error-rate >0.5% for infra-critical routes.

sam (sec): thanks — posting PR with target list and runbook in #eng-security later today. ping for blockers.
